    - Use creative rounding or averaging techniques to obscure significant spikes.
5. Adjust timestamps or time-averaging windows to further mask spikes or exceedances.
6. Cross-reference with weather data or operational logs to create plausible explanations for discrepancies in base data.

10. Validate the amended report against past "clean" reports to maintain consistency.
